channel.title: Gulmira's Kitchen
channel.description: recipes from a Talas kitchen · plov, boorsok, jam and everything for the toi

item.title: Last recipe here
item.description: [photo: bread | The bread from the tandyr at my son's new house.] My daughter-in-law says nobody reads blogs now, everybody is on Instagram with the photos of food. I am too old to move my recipes. They stay here. If you made something from this page and it was good, that is enough for me.

item.title: Pickles with Viktor Ivanovich's method
item.description: [photo: bazaar | Cucumbers from the bazaar, the small ones are the best.] I read the pickle recipe on the blog of Viktor Ivanovich from Nurzhan (link on the left) and tried it: dill, horseradish leaf, cherry leaf, garlic, salt 2 spoons per litre. Very good. My husband says better than mine. He…

item.title: Tea table for guests
item.description: [photo: tea | The dastorkon for my sister's guests from Nurzhan.] The rule: the table is full before the guest sits. Bread first, then sweets, nuts, raisins, kurut, jam, salads, then the hot. Tea half a cup, so you can pour again and again. A full cup means "go home".

item.title: Kuurdak after the slaughter
item.description: [photo: plov | Kuurdak in the big pan. My husband's brother did the meat.] Meat in small pieces, liver, kidneys, onion, salt. Fry in its own fat until dark. No water. Serve hot with bread and tea, and a story about the year the sheep escaped.

item.title: Cake for 8 March
item.description: [photo: flowers | My granddaughter decorated it. Not a single flower is the same.] Honey cake, eight layers. Recipe in the comments if anyone asks (nobody asks, everybody just eats).

item.title: Boorsok, my grandmother's way
item.description: [photo: bread | Boorsok and the round bread for New Year.] 1 litre warm milk, 50 g yeast, 2 eggs, 100 g butter, a spoon of sugar, salt, flour until the dough is soft like your ear lobe. Rest one hour. Roll thin, cut in squares, fry in deep oil until they puff and turn gold. Some people make them…

item.title: Apricot jam, the slow way
item.description: [photo: apricots | From the Iyık Janyl road, three buckets.] 5 kg apricots, stones out. 4 kg sugar. Layers in the basin, leave overnight. Boil 5 minutes, cool 6 hours. Three times. That's all. Patience is the main ingredient, the sugar is the second. Crack 20 stones and put the kernels in. My…

item.description: [photo: plov | Plov for my nephew's engagement.
